notes.title: updates
notes.content:
We’ve released a fresh visual update to bring even more life and personality to the characters as they await your command!

Check it out, and if you’re enjoying the game, please consider leaving a positive review and spreading the word—it really helps us out!

notes.title: Gallery mode added
notes.content:
By popular demand, we've added a Gallery Mode for those who have completed the game!

If you previously mentioned the lack of a gallery in your review, feel free to update it now.

Also, if you’ve enjoyed the game, we’d really appreciate it if you could leave a positive review. Your support helps us grow our community and continue improving the experience for everyone. Thank you!

notes.title: Update 3: extra story stages and further difficulty adjustments
notes.content:
Ok here is update 3 which includes additional stages and cutscenes as well as making earlier stages a bit more easier (dont worry later stages are still challenging but there should be a better difficulty curve to get people more experienced)

As always PLEASE let me know your thoughts and i you enjoy the game please leave a positive review and help spread the word !

notes.title: Update 2: additional Music, animations and adjustments to difficulty
notes.content:
This second update brings several exciting improvements:

[list]
[*] More Music – We've expanded the already large selection of enjoyable tracks.
[*] Additional Stage Poses – Each stage now features new poses for added variety.
[*] Balanced Difficulty – The first few stages have been made easier to create a smoother learning curve for new players.
[/list]

I'm still considering a future update that adds a gallery, but I want to ensure it enhances replayability rather than taking away from the experience.

Hope you enjoy the update! If you do, please don’t forget to leave a positive review and help spread the word about the game!

notes.title: Update 1: additional easy tutorial stage
notes.content:
Thank you for all the positive reviews and feedback so far!

I've just released the first update for the game, which includes a brand-new easy stage to help players get accustomed to the gameplay mechanics. This update also adds additional story elements and text-based cutscenes.

I hope this makes the game more accessible and enjoyable for everyone, and I look forward to seeing even more positive reviews!

Next, I'm working on another update that will introduce a gallery feature and possibly an additional level—so stay tuned!
